title: ze_amdaporkeep
description: Omega mode's Laser Omega: shoot Omega down through its laser waves, then run onto the platform behind it and dodge Omega-F's red and Omega-M's blue lasers.

scenarios.name: Laser Omega (full)
scenarios.summary: Boss lasers, then red and blue lasers
scenarios.description: Temp_Laser_Omega.FireUser1 (Omega_Trigger, 34.5 s after the humans reach the hall) spawns Omega at the end of the hall. Laser_Omega_Hp starts at 20 and Boss_HP_Case adds 90 per human; every bullet on Laser_Omega_Hitobx takes 1 off. You start past the shield, so the outputs of Laser_Omega_Enable_Trigger are fired as the team crossing it 5 s in, once Omega has appeared and taken its HP (it is immune, Filter_Nada, until 1.5 s after the crossing): Omega's shield goes up behind you and Laser_Omega_Timer starts 2.5 s after the crossing: every 0.9-1.2 s a killing laser (Laser_Omega_Hurt, 999999) comes down the hall at one of 8 heights / tilts (Laser_Omega_case). At 0 HP Laser_Omega_Ending spawns Omega-F (red) and Omega-M (blue) at x 2244, and 13 s later each fires 3 random lasers (Laser_Omega_F_case / _M_case PickRandomShuffle at +1.25, +2.05, +3.3 s) and a vertical one (+4.45 s) toward the platform behind Omega. A laser does no damage itself: a red one gives you the VirusR context, a blue one VirusB, and 0.02 s later tests the other colour's filter. So the first colour that touches you is yours, and the other colour kills you (Player_NukeHurt, 2500). At +18.5 s the platform (Omega_Ending_Platform_Train) rises; Level_Ending_Omega at the top wins.

scenarios.name: Omega's lasers
scenarios.summary: Shoot Omega down through its lasers
scenarios.description: The boss part alone: Temp_Laser_Omega.FireUser1, Omega's laser waves every 0.9-1.2 s at 8 heights / tilts (jump or crouch them), 20 + 90 HP per human. Win when Laser_Omega_Hp empties (Laser_Omega_Ending.FireUser4).

scenarios.name: Red and blue lasers
scenarios.summary: First colour to hit you is yours
scenarios.description: Omega is killed 5.5 s into a silent 14 s replay (Laser_Omega_Hp set to 0, the map's own OnHitMin); you start on the platform behind where Omega stood, facing back down the hall, 1.5 s before Omega-F and Omega-M appear. 13 s after the death Omega-F (red) and Omega-M (blue) each fire 3 random lasers and a vertical one. The first colour that touches you is yours (VirusR / VirusB context); touching the other colour after that kills you. Then the platform rises to Level_Ending_Omega.
